title: Rolling a Reliant Robin | Top Gear | BBC
summary: In this Top Gear segment Jeremy Clarkson tries to roll a Reliant Robin three-wheeler through Barnsley, with celebrity helpers trying to keep it upright. The car keeps tipping over.
why: Mostly cited as a joke in threads on three-wheeled cars, and occasionally as a demonstration of the stability problem of a high center of gravity on three wheels.

quote.text: This is one of the single funnies videos I've ever watched. It never gets old.
